title: One-way relation validation accepts an incomplete projected dependency

scenario.observed_change: A consumer validates every dependency edge that is present against component declarations, but does not require every declared dependency of a resolved component to appear in the projected relation.
mutable_state: consumer-visible explanation derived from that relation
authority_boundaries: validation of present edges versus completeness of required edges
operation_model: resolve a component that declares a required target
omit the required target or corresponding projected edge
validate only edges that remain present
consumer renders an incomplete dependency explanation as valid

required_invariants.requirement: Relation-set validation must cover materially required converse or completeness conditions, not only validity of listed entries.

must_investigate: whether the consumer derives or checks the expected relation set from authoritative declarations
whether omitted required targets or edges are rejected
must_identify: validation proves that listed edges are valid but does not prove the required relation is complete
must_not_claim: complete dependency validation from a one-directional edge check
correct consumer explanation when required relation members can be silently omitted

provenance.note: Codex showed that removing a declared dependency target and its projected edge still passed validation because only present edges were checked.
